title: Exact full-update versus output-head midpoint branch residual

hypothesis.claim: The retained full-update F trace assigns more truth-path probability than output-head-only O on second-half branches after each decoder-visible 32-symbol first half, with positive ideal-bit savings in every chronological third and at least 95 percent of segments.
hypothesis.minimumInterpretation: A pass authorizes one prospectively contracted deep-feature instrumentation experiment; it does not authorize a student correction, an archive-gain claim, or score credit.
excludedInterpretations: F-minus-O ideal bits equal realizable arithmetic archive savings
hidden teacher state is decoder-visible or shippable
the residual transfers beyond this retained population
the output-head-only GRAM-MIDAS lineage is revived

population.selection: All retained indexed branch rows; second-half rows have original ordinal modulo 64 in [32, 63].
population.coordinate: Original transformed-symbol ordinal, not execution order.

arms.mechanism: Full deep midpoint parameter update followed by state rebuild.
Output-head-only midpoint parameter update under the same segment schedule.

changedVariables: F updates the complete teacher parameter set at each midpoint; O updates only embed_out and out_bias.
invariants: Both traces contain the same original and execution ordinals, symbols, vocabulary, branch topology, and truth bits.
No teacher is executed and no retained trace is modified.
Truth-path ideal-bit deltas are derived from the retained integer branch probabilities without claiming isolated arithmetic-coder bytes.
First-half and second-half effects remain separate because prior segment updates can affect later first halves.
The analysis receives zero objective and frontier credit.

observableInputs: decoded truth-path bits through the current branch
retained quantized branch probabilities from F and O for attribution only
forbiddenInputs: unrecorded teacher logits or hidden activations
teacher parameters in a submitted codec
trace-derived probabilities in a promoted student

measurements.definition: Exact identity of row coordinates, symbols, topology, and truth bits across F and O.
Sum over second-half truth branches of log2(realized_F_probability / realized_O_probability).
Minimum second-half ideal-bit savings across three original-coordinate chronological thirds.
Fraction of 64-symbol segments whose second-half F-minus-O ideal-bit savings are positive.

gates.passConsequence: Authorize one new prospective experiment that records compact decoder-visible first-half features and deep F-minus-O second-half residual targets.
gates.failConsequence: Retire DELTA-MIDAS deep residual attribution on this population without teacher instrumentation or parameter sweeps.
